texts: On day 47 of Year 1, the moon was full.
The Council convened at the Watch.
Sailsworn reported to the Council that the salt-bloom store held fourteen weeks of winter supply.
The Council issued the standard winter feather ration to the Stilllight Station.
Bevin Coombe reported to the Council that the Stilllight Lantern had remained free of wraiths.
Tessa Brae reported to the Council that the feather store held eight weeks of supply.
The Council issued an extra feather ration to the Stilllight Station.
The Council issued an extra feather ration to the stations of the West Row.

q2_gaps: day-of-year dating ("on day 47 of Year 1"): (Day <n>) is defined as a calendar day beside (Month <name>), so a numbered day of a year (47) has no well-formed term, and an ordinal era year ("Year 1") has no form distinguishing it from a calendar year

stock-quantity measure phrase ("fourteen weeks of winter supply", "eight weeks of supply"): a measure "of" is excluded from the genitive Possession mapping and no positive encoding is named, so an amount expressed as how long it lasts has no licensed form (the parse reuses the eventuality scale `duration` on an entity)

distribution over a plural in a NON-subject role ("issued an extra feather ration to the stations of the West Row"): the per-member rule machinery is defined for plural subjects (and for a resultative's plural object), leaving a group Recipient's per-member reading unaddressed
review.notes: Capitalized-label handling is exactly per the instruction set: "the Council"/"the Watch" stay common nouns with no Name, while "Stilllight Station"/"Stilllight Lantern"/"West Row" exceed the bare class word and get Name + type atoms; the three reports seal non-factively with only typing and compound-genus atoms projected, and the in-seal past perfect correctly takes no Before. (Possession sk_stations_1 west_row) is the genitive test's else-branch, though PartOf's "member of a group" job is arguably the better fit for stations of a Row.
